help.title: Help Center
help.practiceAnswer: Answer each question and confirm your choice. Correct answers are marked as complete.
help.reminderAnswer: Enable them in Notification Preferences to receive a local reminder every day at 9:00 AM.
help.languageQuestion: How do I change my language?
help.languageAnswer: Choose Language in Settings. It updates the interface and practice answers.
